sources.title: Wikidata Q745296 (Flushing Meadows Corona Park) and the points of its features: Q717956, Q4571746, Q1320229, Q2306200, Q1852081, Q1072882

heightM.note: the tallest observation deck's top above the park (about 226 ft)

treeLowM.note: the lower canopy height of the tree masses

treeSpacingM.note: canopy mound spacing at the finest level at density 1

parkHeadingDeg.note: the compass heading of the park's long axis and its lakes

fountainPool.note: the fair's central plaza (the steel globe's point, Q717956 P625): drawn as a generic round fountain pool with plain jets; no globe replica (LEGAL-1)

pavilion.note: the 1964 exposition pavilion (Q4571746, P625): generic observation towers beside an open ring of columns

towerHighM.note: the tallest tower's deck top: the measured height

towerMidM.note: the middle tower's deck top (about 150 ft)

towerLowM.note: the low tower's deck top (about 60 ft)

museum.note: the art museum's building (Q1320229, P625): a generic long low hall

museumPlan.note: the museum hall's length and width

science.note: the science museum (Q2306200, P625): a generic hall

tennis.note: the tennis centre (Q1852081, P625): paved ground, no trees (its venues are not drawn)

ballpark.note: the Queens ballpark's point (Q1072882, P625): kept clear for its own model

ballparkClearM.note: the radius kept clear round the ballpark

longPool.note: a long formal pool north of the plaza, by eye

fairLawn.note: the open lawns south of the pavilion, by eye

lampSpacingM.note: lamps along the promenades at the finest level

spine0.note: promenade point 0: the north fairgrounds (by eye)

spine1.note: promenade point 1: west of the plaza (by eye)

spine2.note: promenade point 2: past the pavilion (by eye)

spine3.note: promenade point 3: Meadow Lake's north-west shore (by eye)

spine4.note: promenade point 4: along Meadow Lake's west shore (by eye)

spine5.note: promenade point 5: Willow Lake's north shore (by eye)

spine6.note: promenade point 6: the south end (by eye)

cross0.note: cross promenade end 0: the science museum (by eye)

cross1.note: cross promenade end 1: the east side (by eye)

readabilityScale.note: Structures are drawn 1.6 times their real plan and the promenades twice their width so they read at game distance; lamps three times a lamp head. No globe replica, no sculptures, signage or text (LEGAL-1).

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.8; the plan stays the map's park outline (x1.0); structures and promenades take the readability scale.
